BiblicalUsage: Shisha was the father of Elihoreph and Ahiah, the two scribes who served in Solomon's court. His name appears once, in the list of Solomon's officials, and the office his sons held was the same one another scribe had held under David.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God remembers the men behind the throne as well as the kings on it. Shisha's sons kept the records, and their father's name is kept in the record too.
